title: Restore My Quest access for every authenticated member by repairing its exact stale page setting

source.ref: Read-only Frequency Community root page_settings metadata and current admission source, 2026-11-04.

detail: Actual authenticated /crew redirected to /feed. Production metadata confirms exactly one root Space and its /crew page_settings row is published, visibility_role=crew, updated_at=2026-06-22 15:21:37.887+00. The community crew rung is retired and separate from paid Crew entitlement. Current Quest matrix and docs/ROLES.md grant every signed-in member full Quest access, while the shared layout still honors this stale operator visibility gate. PROPOSAL ONLY: exact operator transaction resolves one root, locks only /crew, refuses unless status/visibility/updated_at still match this reviewed snapshot, sets native visibility_role NULL (any authenticated member) and updated_at, verifies one row and unchanged remaining columns. No generic page gate, auth, RLS, role or unrelated route changes. The exact SQL passed eleven disposable PGlite 0.4.0 / PostgreSQL 17.5-compatible fixture cases, including unchanged unrelated rows and rollback/refusal cases; this is not hosted Supabase equivalence. Fresh compare-and-set preflight, exact main-committed SQL hash review/authorization and actual production postconditions are still required before any production execution. Never execute twice; an already-null or changed row refuses. Acceptance: authenticated member /crew reaches My Quest, guest remains signed out, other host-only/draft routes and other Space settings stay enforced.

verify.evidence: Read-only production gate/schema metadata confirms PK(space_id,route), nullable text visibility_role, published root /crew with crew restriction and exact updated_at.
